title: Claim-link security kit
fixture_policy: all synthetic claim material is generated at runtime; no literal token-like fixture
authority_limits: does not persist locator or claim secret
does not call or implement Cloud services
does not assert identity, recipient binding, activation, or settlement
does not implement a consumer UI
verified_properties: exact HTTPS origin and claim path validation fail closed
locator and secret have at least 256-bit encoded material
fragment is synchronously replaced before session use
secret session is consume-once with best-effort byte zeroization
resolver request contains locator path and never fragment or secret
request requires no-referrer and no-store behavior
public resolver failures collapse to claim_unavailable
redaction covers URLs, encoded forms, nested values, errors, telemetry, and evidence
clipboard/share output and post-consumption URL contain no secret

blocks: claims that fragment secrecy is proven in a deployed application
